payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design with kinetic typography. Use: animated text, scroll-triggered reveals, typing effects, letter-by-letter animations, morphing text, gradient text fills, oversized hero text, text as the main visual element.
payload.best_for: Hero sections, marketing sites, video platforms, storytelling, creative portfolios, landing pages
payload.css_technical_keywords: @keyframes for text animation, background-clip: text, GSAP SplitText, typing effect (steps()), transform on letters, scroll-triggered (Intersection Observer), variable fonts for morphing
payload.do_not_use_for: Long-form content, accessibility-critical, data interfaces, forms, elderly users
payload.effects_and_animation: @keyframes text animation, typing effect, background-clip: text, GSAP ScrollTrigger, split text
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Text animations smooth, ☐ Prefers-reduced-motion respected, ☐ Fallback for no-JS, ☐ Mobile performance ok, ☐ Typing effect timed, ☐ Scroll triggers work
payload.keywords: Motion text, animated type, moving letters, dynamic, typing effect, morphing, scroll-triggered text
payload.primary_colors: Flexible - high contrast recommended, bold colors for emphasis, animation-friendly palette
payload.secondary_colors: Accent colors for emphasis, transition colors, gradient text fills
